3rd Municipal District (Thiseio, Petralona, Votanikos) — Athens, Greece

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

This district covers Thiseio, Petralona, Rouf, Votanikos and Elaionas. Thiseio and Petralona are described in the city's own official tourism guide as gentrified, pleasant residential and nightlife areas with no documented safety concerns. Votanikos and Elaionas are an industrial fringe area; a 2020 report documented urban decay there, and a refugee reception facility that had operated in the area was evacuated and closed in late 2022, a historical rather than ongoing issue. Rouf shows no documented pattern of incidents in daytime visits or press coverage. Overall the district is rated green by day and yellow at night, reflecting the industrial, sparsely populated character of its western edge after dark rather than any specific documented crime pattern. Sources checked: This is Athens; Alpha TV; Eretikos.gr; CNN.gr; Greek Council for Refugees; Plum Guide.
